# Components

87 components in 11 groups. Each has a live page in the app's UI Kit (`/ui`) with a playground, examples you can view in dark mode, right-to-left and at phone width, the exact code, keyboard and accessibility notes, and a props table.

```tsx
import { Button, DataTable, Modal } from '@/components/kit';
import { AreaChart, DonutChart } from '@/components/charts'; // charts load only where used
```

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/gen-components.mjs from src/showcase/registry.ts. Don't edit by hand. -->

## Layout

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Divider** | Horizontal or vertical rule, with an optional label in the middle. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/divider) |
| **Grid** | CSS grid with a column count per breakpoint, or as many columns as fit a minimum width. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/grid) |
| **PageHeader** | Title, description, breadcrumbs and actions for the top of a page. Can stick under the top bar with a shadow once the page scrolls. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/page-header) |
| **ResizablePanels** | Two panels with a draggable divider. Sizes can be saved per browser, and the divider works from the keyboard. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/resizable-panels) |
| **ScrollArea** | A scroll box with a slim scrollbar and soft shadows that show there is more above or below. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/scroll-area) |
| **Section** | A titled block within a page, optionally in a card. Ideal for settings screens. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/section) |
| **Stack** | Flexbox row or column with gaps from the spacing scale. Direction and gap can change at each breakpoint. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/stack) |

## Buttons & actions

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Button** | Six variants in three sizes, with icon slots, a loading state that keeps its width, and press feedback that doesn’t ripple. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/button) |
| **ButtonGroup** | Joins related buttons into one control, horizontally or vertically, or lays them out with a gap. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/button-group) |
| **CopyButton** | Copies text to the clipboard and confirms with a tick. Icon-only inside fields, or with a label. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/copy-button) |
| **IconButton** | A square button for a single icon. The label is required: it names the button for screen readers and doubles as its tooltip. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/icon-button) |
| **SplitButton** | A main action with related alternatives tucked into a menu on the caret. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/split-button) |
| **ToggleGroup** | Segmented control for switching views or settings. Single choice slides a highlight between options; multiple choice toggles each one. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/toggle-group) |

## Form inputs

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Checkbox** | Tri-state checkbox with a label and description. hideLabel keeps the name for screen readers only, for table rows. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/checkbox) |
| **Input** | Text field with prefix and suffix slots (icons or text), a clear button, three sizes and every state. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/input) |
| **NumberInput** | Numeric field with − / + buttons, keyboard stepping, limits, decimals and currency or unit affixes. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/number-input) |
| **PasswordInput** | Password field with a show / hide button, an optional strength meter and a live checklist of rules. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/password-input) |
| **RadioGroup** | Choose one option from a short list, as plain radios, a row, or selectable cards (RadioCards). | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/radio-group) |
| **SearchSelect** | Searchable dropdown: single or multi-select, groups, icons, server search, create new, 10,000-row lists. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/search-select) |
| **Slider** | Pick a number or a range by dragging or with the keyboard. Marks, labels, value bubbles and right-to-left support. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/slider) |
| **Switch** | An on / off setting that takes effect straight away. Two sizes, with an optional description and label-first layout for settings rows. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/switch) |
| **Textarea** | Multi-line text that can grow with its content and count characters. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/textarea) |
| **Select** | The browser’s own dropdown, styled to match the other inputs. Best for short fixed lists and on phones, where it opens the system picker; use SearchSelect when people need to search or pick several. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/select) |
| **MentionInput** | A text box that grows as you type, where @ suggests people to mention. Arrow keys pick, Enter or Tab inserts the name, and mentionedIn() tells you who to notify. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/mention-input) |
| **PinInput** | One box per character for verification codes and PINs. Paste a whole code, autofill from SMS, and submit as the last box fills. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/pin-input) |
| **TagInput** | Type values and they become removable tags: keywords, emails to invite, allowed domains. Validation, limits and pasting lists. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/tag-input) |
| **Rating** | Stars (or any icon) to give a score, or to show an average with fractions. Labels for each value and full keyboard support. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/rating) |
| **ColorPicker** | A colour field with preset swatches, a saturation area, hue slider and hex input. Works fully from the keyboard. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/color-picker) |
| **RadioCards** | A RadioGroup laid out as cards with an icon, title and description: plans, delivery options, templates. Wraps to fit the space. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/radio-cards) |

## Forms

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Field** | Wraps any control with a label, hint, error and required mark, and wires up the ids for you. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/field) |
| **Form** | Schema forms with React Hook Form and Zod: one schema gives types and validation, the API’s field errors land under the right inputs, and guard asks before leaving with unsaved changes. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/form) |
| **Wizard** | A multi-step form: a Steps header, sliding panels and Back/Next buttons. Each step validates only its own fields before moving on, and the last one submits the form. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/wizard) |
| **FileUpload** | Drop files or browse. Type and size checks, image previews, per-file progress with cancel and retry. Bring your own upload function (fetch, axios, S3 pre-signed URLs). | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/file-upload) |

## Date & time

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Calendar** | A month grid built on react-day-picker and styled by the theme. Single days, ranges or many days, rules for disabled dates, and month names in the user’s language. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/calendar) |
| **DatePicker** | A date field that opens a Calendar. Earliest and latest dates, rules for unavailable days, month/year dropdowns and a clear button. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/date-picker) |
| **DateRangePicker** | Pick a start and end date across two months, or in one click from presets such as “Last 30 days”. Limits and a longest-range rule. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/date-range-picker) |
| **TimePicker** | Type hours and minutes or pick from a list. The value is always "HH:mm" (24-hour); what people see follows their language’s 12- or 24-hour clock. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/time-picker) |

## Overlays

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **ConfirmDialog** | A ready-made “are you sure?” dialog for destructive or important actions, with a busy state. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/confirm-dialog) |
| **Drawer** | A panel that slides in from the edge for filters, details or quick edits, keeping the page in view behind it. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/drawer) |
| **DropdownMenu** | A menu of actions or options from a button: icons, shortcuts, descriptions, separators, labels, check items, disabled and danger items. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/dropdown-menu) |
| **Modal** | Accessible dialog in five sizes with an icon, subtitle, sticky header and footer, and a locked state while saving. Animates in and out. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/modal) |
| **Popover** | A small floating panel anchored to a button, for quick settings and sharing. Flips to stay on screen and follows the page as it scrolls. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/popover) |
| **Tooltip** | Short help that appears on hover and keyboard focus. Positions itself on any side and flips at the screen edge. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/tooltip) |
| **ContextMenu** | The right-click menu, for rows, cards and files. Also opens with a long press on touch screens and with the keyboard. Same items as DropdownMenu. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/context-menu) |
| **HoverCard** | A preview card that appears when the pointer rests on a link, or the link gets focus: people, records, URLs. Richer than a Tooltip, but never the only way to the information. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/hover-card) |
| **CommandPalette** | Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) to search pages, actions and records from anywhere. Fuzzy matching with highlights, grouped results, recent picks and results loaded from the API as you type. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/command-palette) |

## Navigation

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Breadcrumbs** | Shows where a page sits. Long trails collapse their middle into “…”, which expands on click. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/breadcrumbs) |
| **NavMenu** | The sidebar menu: sections, icons, badges, collapsible nested groups and items that hide when the user lacks a permission. The app’s own sidebar is built with it. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/nav-menu) |
| **Pagination** | Page numbers with gaps (1 … 5 6 7 … 20), optional first / last buttons and a compact “Page 3 of 12” mode. The DataTable footer uses the same logic. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/pagination) |
| **Steps** | Progress through a multi-step flow, across or down. Completed steps can be clickable to go back. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/steps) |
| **Tabs** | Switch between views in the same place. Three styles; the indicator slides between tabs and panels fade in. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/tabs) |

## Feedback

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Alert** | An inline message about the page or a form: info, success, warning or danger, in soft, outline or solid style, with an action and a close button. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/alert) |
| **Banner** | A full-width strip for announcements that apply to the whole app: releases, maintenance, demo mode. Can stick to the top. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/banner) |
| **EmptyState** | What to show when there’s nothing to show: a line illustration (or icon), a title, a hint and the next action. Illustrations follow the theme colours. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/empty-state) |
| **Progress** | Bars and rings for uploads, quotas and completion, plus an indeterminate bar when the end isn’t known. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/progress) |
| **ResultPage** | Full-page outcomes: success, errors (403, 404, 500), maintenance and coming soon. The template’s system pages are built with it. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/result-page) |
| **Skeleton** | Shimmering placeholders in the shape of the content, so the page doesn’t jump when data arrives. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/skeleton) |
| **Spinner** | A small loading indicator. Prefer Skeleton when you know the shape of what’s loading. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/spinner) |
| **Toast** | Short notifications in the corner: four tones, a description, an action like Undo, and promise toasts that turn from loading into success or error. Up to four stack; hovering pauses them. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/toast) |

## Data display

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **Accordion** | Sections that expand and collapse with a height animation. One open at a time, or several. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/accordion) |
| **Avatar** | A photo or initials with a stable colour per name, a presence dot, and stacked groups with a “+N” overflow. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/avatar) |
| **Badge** | Short status labels in seven tones and three styles, with an optional dot. A seed gives any string its own stable colour. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/badge) |
| **Card** | The surface most content sits on: a title row with actions, a body, an optional footer and edge-to-edge media. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/card) |
| **DataTable** | Sorting, search, filters, a column picker, row selection with bulk actions, density, page sizes and CSV export. Pinned and resizable columns, expandable rows, server mode and virtual rows for 10,000+ rows. It remembers each user’s choices. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/data-table) |
| **DescriptionList** | Label and value pairs for detail views (a user, an order, an audit entry) in one to three columns. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/description-list) |
| **Kbd** | Keyboard keys. “mod” shows ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl everywhere else, so one line of code is right on every computer. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/kbd) |
| **List** | Rows of people, files or notifications: a leading avatar or icon, title and description, meta at the end and actions that stay clickable. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/list) |
| **StatCard** | A KPI tile: the number counts up on load, with a coloured change and a sparkline drawn in plain SVG (no chart library). | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/stat-card) |
| **Tag** | Compact labels people can remove or toggle: keywords, filters, selected values. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/tag) |
| **QrCode** | A crisp SVG QR code for links, invites and authenticator setup (it draws the two-step sign-in code). Always dark on a white quiet zone, so every camera reads it, even in dark mode. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/qr-code) |
| **Timeline** | Events in order with a line between them: order tracking, activity logs, histories and changelogs. Icons and tones per event, a pending last step and an alternating layout. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/timeline) |
| **TreeView** | Nested rows that open and close: files, categories, org charts, permission groups. Single or cascading checkbox selection, filtering, children loaded on demand and full arrow-key navigation. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/tree-view) |
| **CodeBlock** | Code with syntax colours for light and dark themes, a copy button, file tabs, line numbers and marked lines. The highlighter (Shiki) and each language load only when a block is shown. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/code-block) |
| **Lightbox** | Pictures (or any preview) full screen over the page, with next and previous, swipe on touch screens, click to zoom, a thumbnail strip and a download button. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/lightbox) |

## Charts

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **LineChart** | Change over time for one or a few series. Themed axes and grid, a crosshair tooltip with every series, a legend that hides series, an optional target line, and a data table for screen readers. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/line-chart) |
| **AreaChart** | A line with a soft fill to show volume over time, or stacked areas for parts of a whole. Same tooltip, legend and table view as LineChart. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/area-chart) |
| **BarChart** | Compare amounts across categories: side by side, stacked, or horizontal for rankings and long names. Thin bars with a rounded end, a 2 px gap in stacks and a tooltip with the total. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/bar-chart) |
| **DonutChart** | Parts of a whole with the total in the middle. Hover a slice or a row to see its value; more than six slices fold into “Other” so colours stay distinct. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/donut-chart) |
| **Gauge** | One number against its range: server load, quota used, progress to a target. Colour bands switch the fill from good to warning to critical. Pure SVG, no chart library. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/gauge) |
| **Heatmap** | A grid where a darker cell means more: busy hours, activity by weekday, cohort retention. One colour from light to dark, a scale under the grid, and a table underneath for screen readers. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/heatmap) |
| **FunnelChart** | How many people make it through each step of a flow, with the share of the start and the drop between steps. Plain HTML bars that grow in on load. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/funnel-chart) |
| **Sparkline** | A word-sized trend line for tables, stat cards and lists. Plain SVG, no chart library, so it’s cheap enough to draw on every row. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/sparkline) |

## Apps & advanced

| Component | What it's for | |
|---|---|---|
| **KanbanBoard** | Columns of cards you drag to reorder or move, with the mouse, a finger (press and hold) or the keyboard. The card lifts as you pick it up and settles where it lands; columns can have a work-in-progress limit. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/kanban-board) |
| **Scheduler** | A calendar of events with month and week views. Overlapping events sit side by side, a red line marks the time now, and with a mouse you can drag events to another day or time. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/scheduler) |
| **RichTextEditor** | Formatted text — headings, lists, links, quotes and code — saved as HTML. Built on Tiptap and loaded the first time an editor is shown. Markdown shortcuts work as you type (“## ”, “- ”, “> ”). | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/rich-text-editor) |
| **NotificationCenter** | A bell with an unread count that opens the latest notifications: All and Unread tabs, Today and Earlier groups, mark read, dismiss and inline actions. NotificationPanel is the same list for a page or drawer. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/notification-center) |
| **ChatPanel** | A conversation: messages grouped by person and day, @mentions and links, files, typing dots, sent and read ticks, a “new messages” button when you’ve scrolled up, and a composer with mentions. | [Live](http://localhost:5173/ui/chat-panel) |

Charts (LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, DonutChart, Gauge, Heatmap, FunnelChart, Sparkline) import from `@/components/charts`; everything else from `@/components/kit`.
